name: markspec-ide
description: MarkSpec language support — diagnostics, completions, and entry block scaffolding for traceable industrial documentation.

markspec.server.path.description: Path to the markspec binary. Defaults to 'markspec' on PATH. Used by both the LSP client and the MCP server registration.

markspec.server.args.description: Arguments passed to the markspec binary to start the LSP server.

markspec.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the MarkSpec LSP server.

markspec.trace.debugLog.description: Path to a writable file for LSP server lifecycle and crash logging. Empty means disabled. Equivalent to setting MARKSPEC_LSP_DEBUG_LOG when spawning the server manually.

markspec.mcp.enabled.description: Register the MarkSpec MCP server with VS Code so Copilot (and other MCP-aware clients) can use it. Disable to remove the registration.

markspec.mcp.args.description: Arguments passed to the markspec binary to start the MCP server. Mirrors 'markspec.server.args' but for the MCP subcommand.
